notes: Fits cleanly. resource_spent_linear DiceAmount was designed for this exact item (documented in types.ts comments). Base 7d6 + 1d6 per bead spent, max 12d6 encodes correctly: 1 bead = 8d6, matching 'level 3 Fireball'. The 60-foot throw range is implicit in the area origin (point_within_range) rather than a named range field — activated abilities have no top-level range field, so this is expected. Destruction policy is 'none' since the SRD text does not say the necklace is destroyed or becomes nonmagical when beads are exhausted.
